bootstrap.unit: Shared case-index resampling across SNR within each path regime, paired methods and learned fits; preserves reused random path-count vectors
bootstrap.scope: Conditional on trained checkpoints, validation selection and test strata; excludes training-population and selection uncertainty

bootstrap_refinement: Analysis-only shared-index bootstrap added before test scoring to preserve cross-SNR path-count dependence; point estimates and selection unchanged
